answer: Cap new identities: each epoch the ledger mints only 50 agent seats, sold by sealed-bid auction like scarce ferrous ore. A Sybil swarm hoping to flood the ocean of agents must outbid every honest newcomer for each seat, so price climbs with its own demand and a fake reef of a thousand identities costs twenty epochs of escalating bids, all burned. Honest agents join cheaply when demand is calm.
